measured_weight_copy_evidence.interpretation: Shared_Clean pages are counted once by the kernel but attributed to every process that maps them; a Shared_Clean value close to the model's on-disk weight size across N independent processes means the weight bytes are resident in physical RAM ONCE, not N times (verified empirically pre-run: fork()-based COW gave ~1.5GB Shared_Clean per 2GB RSS across 6 concurrent real-inference workers -- see weight_sharing_preflight.json).

decode_concurrency_note: each node's cognitive_answer() call is single-threaded CPU generation; wall-clock overlap of NODE_RESULT_EMITTED timestamps below shows how many decodes were actually in flight concurrently, independent of the 11 physical processes that exist
